description: Check the public ECZ-ID Resolver posture of an MCP server, agent, API or business from any MCP-capable agent host. Local-first, read-only, deterministic. Never writes truth, never scores, never uploads source.

defaultPrompt: Does this MCP server have public ECZ-ID proof?
Explain this ECZ-ID ResultState and its ReasonCodes.
Re-check the ECZ-ID Resolver before I rely on this result.
interface.longDescription: Check whether an MCP server, agent, API, package, domain or business has public ECZ-ID Resolver proof, and read the ResultState and ReasonCodes without turning them into a score. The three read-only ECZ-ID Verifier tools are used when the host has the Verifier MCP server configured; otherwise the skill explains the result vocabulary, the policy modes and where to look, and routes to the public Resolver.

name: eczid-mcp-verifier
